arguments.value: Jennifer Guerin Zipps is a United States District Judge for the District of Arizona, having been nominated by President Barack Obama, confirmed by the Senate, and commissioned in 2011. Born in 1964 in Ashland, Ohio, she earned her B.A. from the University of Arizona and her J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center. She served as a law clerk to Judge William C. Canby of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, practiced privately in Tucson, and served as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of Arizona. She also served as a U.S. magistrate judge for the District of Arizona from 2005 to 2011 and has served as chief judge since 2024.
